Subject: Spike in 5xxs + sustained latency from this morning

Hi Monica,

We started seeing a surge in 500s and >1s tail latency against the Redwood endpoint for our nightly ingestion at ~08:40 PT. This started as a small number of errors but has ramped — currently about 12% 5xx rate for requests from our ingestion job and a lot of retries from our side. From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai
Cc: devops-team@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2026 14:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Spike in 5xxs + sustained latency from this morning

Summary (root cause & immediate mitigation):

Root cause: A recent change to the per-tenant rate governor (rolled last night at 01:00 PT to tighten cross-tenant burst isolation) inadvertently changed the banked-credit expiry window. For long-running batch ingestion patterns (Asteron's nightly job) banked credits were expiring too quickly which caused the governor to force hard throttles once short-term credits were exhausted. That combined with an automated fallback to a lower-capacity model variant for high-concurrency spikes produced increased latency and 500s when the fallback paths saturated.

Evidence:
- Banking window for tenant credits set to 4h (should be 24h) in the new config (diff attached: governor_config_v2.diff).
- Corresponding spike on our side at 08:40 PT, aligned with their ingestion schedule.
- Sample requests show typical long-context batches that consumed credits rapidly.

Immediate mitigation implemented at 14:05 PT:
- Ops temporarily bumped Asteron's burst allocation and extended banked-credit expiry to 24h for their tenant.
- Disabled the automatic fallback to the lower-capacity variant for the affected route.
- Increased connection-level timeouts on the serving layer for ongoing requests (to avoid premature 5xx).

Status: error rate dropped from ~12% to ~1.4% within 10 minutes of the change; throughput returned to ~96% of baseline. Monitoring dashboards updated.

Follow-ups (action items):
- Permanently revert the buggy config in the next deploy or add a targeted flag to exclude batch-heavy tenants (OWNER: infra/config team).
- Add regression tests for banked-credit expiry semantics using long-tail batch patterns (OWNER: infra/qol).
- Customer communications: Monica to send a short post-mortem to Asteron by EOD; Karthik/Marissa to review wording.

Attachments: governor_config_v2.diff, traffic-graphs-20260422.png

Markus
Staff Engineer, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference
